fields.name: admin
docs: Authority allowed to update config parameters and manage the manager whitelist.

fields.name: nav_updater
docs: Authority allowed to post vault NAV updates.

fields.name: treasury_authority
docs: Authority allowed to claim platform fee shares.

fields.name: guardian
docs: Authority allowed to pause the protocol, and nothing else.

fields.name: next_vault_id
docs: Vault ID, increments with each new vault.

fields.name: platform_performance_fee_bps
docs: Fee taken from profits above the high water mark that goes to the platform, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: platform_management_fee_bps
docs: Annualized fee taken on total assets that goes to the platform, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: max_nav_deviation_bps
docs: Max NAV per share change accepted from the updater in a single update, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: max_epoch_outflow_bps
docs: Max share of total assets that withdrawals can pay out per epoch, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: status
docs: Determines operational status of the protocol.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version, see [CONFIG_VERSION].

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Admin nominated through `config_update`, becomes admin once it signs `admin_accept`. Default pubkey when none.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
docs: Max slippage accepted on a routed swap, denoted in basis points. Zero means [DEFAULT_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS].

types.name: DepositRequest
docs: Pending deposit, resolvable once the vault NAV is updated in a later epoch.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority of the request, receives the minted shares.

fields.name: vault
docs: The vault this request is for.

fields.name: amount
docs: Deposit mint amount held in the vault's deposit escrow.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Epoch the request was made in.

fields.name: created_ts
docs: Timestamp the request was created.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields.

types.name: Manager
docs: Whitelist entry allowing `authority` to create vaults. Created and closed by the config admin.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to create vaults.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields.

fields.name: amount_x
docs: Total fees claimed into the vault, including the treasury share.

fields.name: bps_to_remove
docs: Portion of liquidity to remove across the full position range.

types.name: Strategy
docs: Record of where a vault's funds are utilized. Holds no accounting, NAV is tracked off-chain.

fields.name: vault
docs: The vault this strategy belongs to.

fields.name: created_ts
docs: Timestamp the strategy was created.

fields.name: last_action_ts
docs: Timestamp of the last execute/exit on the strategy.

fields.name: id
docs: ID unique to the strategy within the vault.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version, see [STRATEGY_VERSION].

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields, the enum has to stay last.

fields.name: strategy_type
docs: Details about the underlying protocol and action of the strategy.

fields.name: id
docs: Unique vault ID.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority allowed to manage the vault.

fields.name: name
docs: Name of the vault (utf8 bytes, padded with 0s).

fields.name: reserved_keys
docs: 80..144, reserved for two future `Pubkey` fields (e.g. `pending_authority`, `delegate`).
Vault metadata beyond `name` lives off-chain.

fields.name: deposit_mint
docs: Mint accepted as vault deposits.

fields.name: share_mint
docs: Mint of the tokenized vault shares, authority is the vault.

fields.name: deposit_cap
docs: Max total assets accepted including pending deposits, denoted in deposit mint.

fields.name: total_assets
docs: Last reported total value of vault holdings, adjusted on request resolution. Denoted in deposit mint.

fields.name: nav_per_share
docs: Last recorded value of one share, scaled by [NAV_PRECISION]. Denoted in deposit mint.

fields.name: high_water_mark
docs: All-time highest recorded NAV per share after fees.
Performance fees are only taken on profits above this mark.

fields.name: nav_epoch
docs: Epoch of the last NAV update.

fields.name: last_nav_ts
docs: Timestamp of the last NAV update, used to prorate management fees.

fields.name: pending_deposits
docs: Total deposit mint held in deposit escrow awaiting resolution.

fields.name: pending_withdrawal_shares
docs: Total shares held in share escrow awaiting resolution.

fields.name: unclaimed_manager_fee_shares
docs: Fee shares accrued to the vault manager, minted on claim.

fields.name: unclaimed_platform_fee_shares
docs: Fee shares accrued to the platform, minted on claim.

fields.name: epoch_outflow
docs: Deposit mint paid out to withdrawals since the last NAV update.

fields.name: next_strategy_id
docs: Next strategy ID, increments with each new strategy.

fields.name: performance_fee_bps
docs: Fee taken from profits above the high water mark that goes to the vault manager, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: management_fee_bps
docs: Annualized fee taken on total assets that goes to the vault manager, denoted in basis points.

fields.name: status
docs: Determines operational status of the vault.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version, see [VAULT_VERSION].

fields.name: deposit_paused
docs: Nonzero when the manager has paused deposit requests and their resolution.

fields.name: withdrawal_paused
docs: Nonzero when the manager has paused withdrawal requests and their resolution.

fields.name: reserved0
docs: 312..320, reserved for `epoch_duration`.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit accepted per request, denoted in deposit mint. Zero disables the check.

fields.name: min_withdrawal_shares
docs: Smallest shares accepted per withdrawal request unless it is the withdrawer's full balance. Zero disables the check.

fields.name: reserved1
docs: 336..360, reserved for `last_override_ts`, `total_deposited`, `total_withdrawn`.

fields.name: fee_effective_ts
docs: Timestamp from which the pending fees apply, zero when no fee change is pending.

fields.name: reserved2
docs: 368..380, reserved for `epoch_inflow` and per-vault deviation/outflow bps.

fields.name: pending_performance_fee_bps
docs: Performance fee that replaces [Vault::performance_fee_bps] once [Vault::fee_effective_ts] has passed.

fields.name: pending_management_fee_bps
docs: Management fee that replaces [Vault::management_fee_bps] once [Vault::fee_effective_ts] has passed.

fields.name: open_strategy_count
docs: Strategies currently open on the vault, must be zero before the vault can be closed.

fields.name: reserved3
docs: 388..424, reserved for `nav_update_count` and future fields.

types.name: WithdrawalRequest
docs: Pending withdrawal, resolvable once the vault NAV is updated in a later epoch.

fields.name: authority
docs: Authority of the request, receives the redeemed deposit mint.

fields.name: vault
docs: The vault this request is for.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares held in the vault's share escrow.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Epoch the request was made in.

fields.name: created_ts
docs: Timestamp the request was created.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for future fields.

constants.name: CONFIG_VERSION
docs: Layout versions, bumped whenever an account grows. Zero means the pre-versioned layout.

constants.name: DEFAULT_MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
docs: Max embedded Jupiter slippage accepted when [Config::max_slippage_bps] is unset (legacy zero).

constants.name: EPOCH_DURATION
docs: Duration of a NAV epoch in seconds. NAV is updated at most once per epoch.

constants.name: FEE_INCREASE_DELAY
docs: Delay before a manager fee increase takes effect, so depositors can exit first.

constants.name: NAV_PRECISION
docs: Precision of NAV per share, 1e9 = 1 deposit mint unit per share.

constants.name: SECONDS_PER_YEAR
docs: Used to prorate annualized management fees.

constants.name: TREASURY_CLAIM_FEE_BPS
docs: Share of fees claimed from a protocol position that is sent to the treasury.
